levels.description:
ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, and Talent 1's splash area <@ba.vup>expands</>; while skill is active, can deploy a Blood's Whisper, which <$ba.attract>Lures</> up to <@ba.vup>{max_target}</> enemies who enter its range and can path to it (prioritizing elite or leader enemies) for <@ba.vup>10</>s after deployment; once the first target arrives at its position, retreats and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> all surrounding enemies for <@ba.vup>{buff_time}</>s, dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Tragodia's ATK as Arts damage and <@ba.vup>{ep_damage_ratio_token:0%}</> of Tragodia's ATK as <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> every <@ba.vup>{interval_damage}</>s
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration; Blood's Whisper has an independent Redeployment Time</>
